title: Buy cards with Intake
subtitle: Track what you pay for every card that comes in

steps.intro: Intake tracks the cards you buy from customers, vendors or opened product.
steps.newIntake: Start a new intake when cards come in.
steps.source: Choose where the cards are coming from.
steps.name: Enter the customer's name.
steps.collection: Cards you scan go straight into this collection.
steps.scanner: The scanner opens so you can scan the customer's cards.
steps.openIntake: Back on Intake, open the buy you just started.
steps.addCard: You can also add a card by hand.
steps.pickCard: Pick the printing to add it to the intake.
steps.liveOffer: The cash and credit offers update as each card is added.
steps.finish: When the customer accepts, choose Finish to pay out and add the cards to your stock.
steps.moreActions: If they change their mind, open More actions.
steps.confirmCancel: The cards go back to the customer and nothing is paid.
